title: cargo xtask CLI command schema
description: Machine-readable description of every `cargo xtask <command>` invocation accepted by xtask/src/main.rs. Each branch of the root `oneOf` corresponds to one match arm in `main()`. Generated by hand from source (xtask/src/main.rs) — regenerate manually when main.rs's match arms change; there is no build-time codegen for this file.

test.description: Run a test suite. `cargo xtask test <suite>`. Bare `cargo xtask test` prints the suite list and exits 0.

suite.description: e2e-suite and system-suite are the same target (dispatch_test treats them identically).

check.description: Static checks. `cargo xtask check <target> [flags...]`. Bare `cargo xtask check` prints the target list.

update.description: Write current hashes into xtask/protocol-drift.lock instead of comparing.

hook.description: Read tool_input.file_path from stdin (Claude Code PostToolUse hook JSON) and only check if that path is a tracked surface.

sarif.description: Write a SARIF report to this path in addition to normal output.

file.description: File to scan for HandlerDependencies construction sites.

strict.description: Exit non-zero if any .unwrap() calls are found outside test infrastructure. Without --strict, findings are printed as a warning and the command exits 0.

docs.description: Documentation tools. `cargo xtask docs <action> [flags...]`. Bare `cargo xtask docs` prints the action list.

full.description: Full audit mode instead of Quick.

strict.description: Only meaningful in Quick mode (ignored when --full is set).

sarif.description: Write a SARIF report of frontmatter/status violations.

info.description: Introspection. `cargo xtask info <target> [flags...]`. Bare `cargo xtask info` prints the target list.

save.description: Persist the snapshot to disk in addition to printing it.

base_ref.description: Git ref to diff against. Emits GitHub Actions step outputs classifying changed paths.

verify.description: Read-only local gate: fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, clippy -D warnings, borrow-reasoning fixtures, docs lint. Never mutates files. Checkpointed (skipped if tree hash unchanged since last pass).

lint.description: fmt --check + clippy -D warnings + cargo check --workspace across the full adapter matrix. Checkpointed.

fix.description: Mutating: cargo fmt --all, git add -u, version bump, clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged, git add -u again. Only runs if Rust files are staged.

pre-commit.description: Validation-only pre-commit gate (invoked by the git pre-commit hook): fmt + clippy on staged Rust files, agentlint on staged agent config files, actionlint on staged workflow files, docs-lint, FEATURE_MATRIX date stamp update, repo-cleanliness warning. Never runs release build or conformance suite.

prepush.description: Release build (miniboxd, minibox-core, mbx, minibox, minibox-macros) + nextest (release profile) + conformance suite. Skipped entirely if no Rust files are in the push range. Checkpointed.

all.description: Lint every agent config file in the repo instead of only staged ones.

coverage.description: Generate a coverage report (lcov and/or HTML).

open.description: Open the HTML report after generating it.

build-test-image.description: Cross-compile the test binaries and package an OCI tarball for VM-based testing.

force.description: Rebuild even if a cached image already exists.

setup-test-vm.description: Build/refresh a persistent smolvm VM with a Rust toolchain, for macOS-side testing.

test-in-vm.description: Dual-backend (native minibox + smolvm) test run inside a VM.

keep.description: Keep the VM/container after the run instead of tearing it down.

test-linux.description: Cross-compile (zigbuild), build a CPIO initramfs, and run tests inside a smolvm QEMU VM against the cross-compiled binaries. No flags — all configuration comes from xtask/xconfig (XConfig::load).

nuke-test-state.description: Kill orphaned test processes, unmount leaked overlay mounts, and remove stale cgroups/temp state. Safe cleanup for a machine with accumulated test cruft.

preflight.description: Verify required tools are on PATH (cargo, cargo-nextest, gh).

doctor.description: Full preflight diagnostics (compiled adapters, capability probes) — same underlying probe as `mbx doctor`.

available.description: Check whether the xtask binary itself is available/buildable. Undocumented: not listed in print_help(), but reachable as a top-level match arm.

promote.description: Cascade-merge one stability tier into the next (develop -> next -> staging -> main), gated on CI green for the source branch.

from.description: Defaults to inferring from the current branch if omitted.

to.description: Defaults to the next tier after --from if omitted.

dry_run.description: Print the cascade plan without merging.

ci-watch.description: Watch the most recent GitHub Actions run with job-level detail.

daily-orchestration.description: Run the daily maintenance orchestration pass.
daily-orchestration.notes: Unrecognized flags other than --ci/--dry-run cause a usage error (unlike most other xtask parsers, which just warn and ignore).

council.description: Run devloop council analysis against a base ref.

bench.description: Run Criterion benchmarks and save results to bench/results/.

check.description: Regression-check mode: compare against a saved baseline instead of running+saving.

env.description: Environment label used to select/save the correct baseline file.

bench.notes: Unrecognized flags produce a warning and are ignored, not a hard error.

demo.description: Short end-to-end demonstration: pull + run against the named adapter. Exits 0 even on command failure (advisory).

borrow-fixtures.description: Run borrow-reasoning must-pass/must-fail fixtures (compile-time checks that specific borrow patterns do/don't compile).

clippy-sarif.description: Run clippy and write results as a SARIF report.

cas-add.description: Add a file to the content-addressed overlay store.

ref.description: Named reference to attach to the stored object.

cas-check.description: Verify overlay refs match their CAS objects.

lint-paths.description: Lint path-handling code. Undocumented: not listed in print_help(), but reachable as a top-level match arm.

run.description: Run a Nushell script from scripts/<name>.nu, forwarding remaining args. Errors with the available script list if the named script doesn't exist.
